title: Lists vs Sets vs Sorted Sets — Pick the Right Type
summary: Compare FIFO List queues, unique Set collections, and prioritized Sorted Set leaderboards, observing their underlying physical encodings.

steps.title: Build a FIFO queue with List (RPUSH / LPOP)
steps.explanation: Redis lists are doubly-linked quicklists of listpack nodes. RPUSH appends to the tail ($O(1)$) and LPOP removes from the head ($O(1)$), making lists ideal for job queues.

steps.title: Enforce uniqueness with Set (SADD)
steps.explanation: Redis sets store unordered unique members using an intset (for pure integers) or a hash table. SADD ignores duplicate entries automatically.

steps.title: Rank elements by score with Sorted Set (ZADD / ZREVRANGE)
steps.explanation: Sorted Sets pair every member with a floating-point score using a dual hash table + skiplist data structure. Traverse ranks in O(log N + M) time.
